header.title: Blocked page, limited roast
header.subtitle: The page could not be meaningfully analyzed because access was blocked (login, bot protection, or permission gate).
header.verdict_chip: Unblock access to get a real roast

summary_panel.one_liner: This result reflects access failure more than page quality. The analyzer mostly saw a gate/blocked state instead of the landing page.
top_3_problems: Analyzer could not access the actual landing page content
Result confidence is low because evidence is blocked
summary_panel.cta_hint: Retry with a public URL or temporary preview link that loads without login/bot checks.

issue_cards.title: The analyzer saw a gate page instead of your offer
issue_cards.problem: The captured page state did not expose the landing page headline, offer, or CTA content.
issue_cards.why_it_hurts: Without the actual page, the roast cannot evaluate messaging, structure, or conversion path quality.

evidence.value: Visible page state appears to be a login/challenge/permission gate

issue_cards.fix: Provide a publicly accessible URL or a preview/staging link that loads without authentication or bot protection.

issue_cards.title: Observed CTAs belong to the gate, not the product page
issue_cards.problem: Any visible buttons are likely for login, verification, or access recovery rather than the landing page conversion flow.
issue_cards.why_it_hurts: CTA analysis would be misleading because it reflects the blocker UI, not your marketing page intent.

evidence.value: Visible actions appear related to access, not product evaluation or signup intent

issue_cards.fix: Retry once the page is accessible so the analyzer can inspect the real primary CTA and next-step wording.

issue_cards.title: Proof elements were not visible for analysis
issue_cards.problem: The analyzer could not inspect testimonials, customer logos, or social proof blocks because the page content never loaded.
issue_cards.why_it_hurts: Trust/proof scoring is effectively unavailable in a blocked state.

evidence.value: Landing page sections were not rendered in the captured state

issue_cards.fix: Use a direct page URL that resolves to the public landing page without redirects to auth or challenge flows.

items.note: Actual offer content was not visible due to blocked access.
Audience targeting could not be assessed from the blocked page state.
Landing page headline was not accessible.
Observed actions were related to access gating, not the product CTA.
Differentiation could not be evaluated because product messaging was unavailable.
Only the blocked/gate UI structure was visible, which is not representative.
Objection handling could not be assessed.
Mobile score reflects blocked-state visibility, not the landing page UX.

quick_wins_section.title: Quick Wins
quick_wins_section.subtitle: Before re-running
items: Use a publicly accessible URL that loads without login.
Temporarily disable bot/challenge protection for the preview URL if possible.
Verify the page resolves directly to the landing page (not an app dashboard redirect).

headlines: Unable to generate headline rewrites from blocked page content

subheadlines: Once the page is accessible, the roast can generate targeted headline, subheadline, and CTA alternatives.
This placeholder rewrite pack exists only to preserve the pass2 UI contract in blocked-page scenarios.

mobile_section.title: Mobile Roast
findings: Mobile analysis was blocked by the same access gate
Observed mobile UI may reflect a challenge/login screen rather than the landing page
Use a public preview link to get meaningful mobile conversion feedback

positives_section.title: What's Working
items: The system detected and reported a blocked-state scenario instead of inventing detailed page feedback.
Retry guidance is clear and actionable for obtaining a valid roast.
